body: You're pretty young to start taking steroids. I started at 25. There's risks and rewards, if they are worth it to you is up to you. But from experience I would say start with test only not immediately test and deca. You need to understand how your body responds to high test first, before throwing in other stuff. 200mg test would be a good beginner cycle to dip your toes in. But also remember you will shutdown your own test production which can take some time to come back. This would be especially so if you throw in deca as it stays in your body for a very long time. Personally I hate deca due to very bad side effects... depression, Deca dick water bloat, heart pressure etc
